definitions.explanation: A temporary outdoor shop or stall, commonly seen at festivals, markets, and events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{露店|ろてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Street stalls lined up at the festival.

examples.japanese: {露店|ろてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought yakisoba from a street stall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{参道|さんどう}→参道：11980_sandou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{露店|ろてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ていた→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Various street stalls were set up along the approach to the shrine.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧: also means street stall/food cart (more common term)
- {出店|でみせ}: vendor stall at an event
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: general word for shop

COMMON FESTIVAL STALLS:
- ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧ (fried noodles)
- ⟦たこ{焼|や}き→たこ焼き：10364_takoyaki⟧ (takoyaki)
- ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦{飴|あめ}→飴：00687_ame⟧ (candy apples)
- ⟦{金魚|きんぎょ}すくい→金魚すくい：14661_kingyosukui⟧ (goldfish scooping)
- ⟦{射的|しゃてき}→射的：24090_shateki⟧ (shooting gallery)

{露店|ろてん} literally means 'dew shop,' referring to being exposed to the elements.
